NONE: › honest and not telling or containing any lies
誠實的；真實的，正確的

example: a veracious and trustworthy historian
一位誠實可信的歷史學家

NONE: › the quality of being true, honest, or accurate
真實；誠實；實事求是

example: Doubts were cast on the veracity of her alibi.
她不在場證據的真實性開始受到懷疑。

NONE: › a raised, covered, sometimes partly closed area, often made of wood, on the front or side of a building
遊廊；陽台；露臺

example: Every evening we sat on the veranda watching the sun go down.
每天傍晚我們都坐在露臺上看日落。

NONE: A2 a word or phrase that describes an action, condition, or experience
動詞

example: The words "run", "keep", and "feel" are all verbs.
run，keep 和 feel 都是動詞。

NONE: C2 spoken rather than written
口頭的；非書面的
C1 relating to words
用言辭的；文字的

example: a verbal agreement/description/explanation
口頭協議／描述／解釋

航班被延誤，機場的官員們遭到了憤怒的乘客們的語言攻擊。

有時候可能很難用語言來描述顏色、聲音之類的東西。

NONE: › to talk continuously or too much
說個不停；說話太多
› to express ideas, opinions, or emotions in words
用言辭表達

example: He found it hard to verbalize his feelings towards his son.
他覺得難以用語言來描述他對兒子的感情。

NONE: › using exactly the same words as were originally used
一字不差地；逐字地

example: She had an amazing memory and could recall verbatim quite complex conversations.
她記憶力驚人，能夠一字不差地回想起很複雜的談話內容。

NONE: › language that is very complicated and contains a lot of unnecessary words
冗詞，廢話，贅語

example: His explanation was wrapped up in so much technical verbiage that I couldn't understand it.
他的解釋充斥著太多晦澀累贅的專業術語，我根本就聽不懂。

NONE: › using or containing more words than are necessary
囉嗦的；冗長的，累贅的

example: a verbose explanation/report/speech/style
囉嗦的解釋／冗長的報告／冗長的演講／言辭冗贅的風格
He was a notoriously verbose after-dinner speaker.
他在飯後講起話來是出了名地囉嗦。

NONE: › covered with healthy green plants or grass
長滿綠色植物的；草木蒼翠的

example: Much of the region's verdant countryside has been destroyed in the hurricane.
這個地區大片草木蒼翠的鄉村地帶都在那次颶風中毀於一旦。

NONE: C2 an opinion or decision made after judging the facts that are given, especially one made at the end of a trial
（根據事實作出的）意見，決定；（尤指）判決，裁決

陪審團一致判定有罪／無罪。

昨晚選民們以壓倒性的多數票支援反對黨，由此可以看出他們對本屆政府在經濟上的作為的評判。

open verdict

NONE: › a blue-green layer that forms on copper, brass, or bronze
銅綠；銅銹；乙酸銅
› (the green colour of) fresh, healthy plants
青翠的草木；青翠，青蔥
› the edge or border of something
邊；邊緣；邊沿

路邊；路肩

他們在沙漠邊緣紮下了營地。

她把車停在公路旁，沿著長滿草的路邊走到了緊急電話亭。

NONE: › to be almost a particular state, quality, or feeling, especially one that is very bad or very good
接近；瀕臨

他的表現有時候近乎完美，但有時候卻又顯得稀鬆平常。

NONE: › an official in some Churches who takes care of the inside of a church building and performs some simple duties during services
教堂司事
› able to be proved
可證實的；可證明的

example: Throughout the trial, he didn't produce a single verifiable fact.
整個審判過程中，他沒有提供一丁點兒可以證實的事實。

NONE: C1 to prove that something exists or is true, or to make certain that something is correct
證明；證實

你能證明你的陳述／指控／報告／理論嗎？
These numbers are surprisingly high and they'll have to be verified.
這些數字高得令人吃驚，必須加以查證。
[ + (that) ] Under interrogation, she verified (that) the tapes were authentic.
經過審問，她證實那些錄音帶是真實的。

NONE: › in a completely honest way
真正地；真實地
› the quality of seeming true or of having the appearance of being real
貌似真實；逼真

example: She has included photographs in the book to lend verisimilitude to the story.
她在書中使用了照片，以使故事顯得更加真實。

NONE: › used to describe something as another, more exciting, interesting, or unusual thing, as a way of emphasizing its character
十足的，不折不扣的；名副其實的

我度假回來的時候，我的花園簡直是雜草叢生。

色調通常都比較暗淡的男裝部這一季將會成為名副其實的色彩萬花筒。

U: › [ U ] the quality of being true
C: › [ C ] a belief, idea, or principle that is generally accepted as being true

example: In the film, he plays a spy whose mission is to confirm the verity of a secret military document.
在電影中，他扮演一名間諜，肩負的任務是弄清一份秘密軍事文件的真實性。
She has spent her life in a search for eternal/scientific/universal verities.
她畢生致力於追求永恆的／科學／普遍的真理。

NONE: › a type of pasta made in long, thin threads
細麵條；線麵，義大利細麵
› UK extremely small pieces of chocolate used for decorating cakes
（蛋糕上的）巧克力裝飾線條
› a bright red colour
朱紅色，鮮紅色

example: She was wearing a jacket of bright vermilion.
她穿著一件亮紅色的夾克。

NONE: › small animals and insects that can be harmful and are difficult to control when they appear in large numbers
害蟲；害獸

危害社會的人，害人蟲；歹徒

蒼蠅、蝨子和蟑螂都可以被稱作是害蟲。

他認為所有恐怖分子都是害人蟲。

NONE: › covered with insects
滿是蟲子的；有寄生蟲的

滿是寄生蟲的舊毯子

NONE: › a strongly alcoholic red or white wine flavoured with herbs and spices
苦艾酒；味美思酒

本地話，方言；白話

（建築的）本地風格，民間風格

（藝術的）民間風俗

我在學校裡學的西班牙語與我現在住的這個墨西哥村子裡所說的本地方言差別非常大。

很多天主教徒認為用方言代替拉丁語做彌撒是件很讓人惋惜的事。

NONE: › relating to or happening in the spring
春天的；春季發生的
› the time in the spring when the sun crosses the equator, and when night and day are of equal length
春分
› a small, hard, infectious growth on the skin, usually on the bottom of the foot
（腳底的）疣
C2 able to change easily from one activity to another or able to be used for many different purposes
多種用途的；萬用的；多才多藝的

example: He's a very versatile young actor who's as happy in highbrow dramas as he is in TV comedies.
他是一個非常多才多藝的年輕演員，無論是演高雅電影還是電視喜劇都一樣得心應手。
A leather jacket is a timeless and versatile garment that can be worn in all seasons.
皮夾克是一種永不過時、適合多種場合的衣服，可以在任何季節穿。

U: › [ U ] writing that is arranged in short lines with a regular rhythm; poetry
C: B2 [ C ] one of the parts that a poem or song is divided into
› [ C ] one of the series of short parts that the writing of a holy book is divided into

打油／諧趣／諷刺詩

莎士比亞主要用韻文來寫作。

每一節都以獨唱形式演唱，然後所有人一同合唱。
She recited a verse from the Bible/the Koran.
她背誦了《聖經》／《可蘭經》裡的一節。

NONE: › to know a lot about a particular subject or be experienced in a particular skill
對…很熟練；通曉；精通

example: I'm not sufficiently versed in XML to understand what you're saying.
我對可延伸標示語言不太精通，聽不懂你的話。

unversed

NONE: B2 a particular form of something that is slightly different from other forms of the same thing
版本；說法

事件的官方說法是員警受到了攻擊，他們只是想自衛。

你可以用茅屋起司代替奶油起司來製作低脂肪的起司蛋糕。
An English-language version of the book is planned for next year.
那本書的英語版本計劃在明年推出。

這部電視劇對其電影版作了弱化處理，專為闔家觀賞而製作。

NONE: C1 written abbreviation vs, vs., UK also v used to say that one team or person is competing against another
以…為對手；對
› written abbreviation v, vs, vs. used when naming the two sides in a legal case
（訴訟案中）訴

明天的比賽是紐卡素隊對阿仙奴隊。

在羅訴韋德案後，墮胎在美國全國變得合法化。
private education versus state education
私立教育與公營教育相比

NONE: › one of the small bones that form the spine (= back bone)
脊椎骨；椎骨
› relating to the vertebra or spine
脊椎骨的

example: the vertebral column
脊柱

NONE: › the group of animals that have a spine (= a column of bones in the back)
脊椎動物類
› having a spine (= back bone)
有脊椎的
› an animal that has a spine
脊椎動物

example: Birds, fish, and reptiles are all vertebrates.
鳥類、魚類和爬行動物都是脊椎動物。

NONE: › a medical treatment in which a substance that goes hard in the body is injected into the spine through a small hole in the skin to reduce pain in the spine

在進行經皮椎體成形術之前，醫生必須先確定骨折位置。

NONE: › (in mathematics) the point where two lines meet to form an angle, or the point that is opposite the base of a shape
（數學裡的）頂點，角頂

頂點；最高點

example: the vertex of a triangle/cone/pyramid
三角形／圓錐體／棱錐體的頂點

NONE: C1 standing or pointing straight up or at an angle of 90° to a horizontal surface or line
豎直的；垂直的；立式的
› a vertical line, surface, or position
垂直線；垂直面；豎直位置

example: She looked over the cliff and found she was standing at the edge of a vertical drop.
她從懸崖上向下看，發現自己正站在陡直懸崖的邊緣。

horizontal adjective
In a two-stage operation, the steel structure will be raised to the vertical.
在分成兩個步驟的操作中，鋼結構將被豎成垂直狀態。

NONE: › the
y-axis
› a cover for a window made of vertical strips of stiff cloth or plastic that can be moved in order to change the amount of light that is allowed in
豎條百葉窗
› a place where plants or livestock (= animals for food) are grown or kept in tall buildings with many floors
垂直農場
› the activity of making plants grow up a wall or out of a wall, often because there is not much space available on the ground
垂直園藝
› a process in business where a company buys another company that supplies it with goods or that buys goods from it in order to control all the processes of production

› causing or experiencing the feeling that everything is spinning around
引起暈眩的；感到暈眩的

那兩座摩天大樓由一條看著眼暈的空中走廊連接。

NONE: › a feeling of spinning around and being unable to balance, often caused by looking down from a height
（從高處俯視感到的）暈眩

example: She can't stand heights and has always suffered from vertigo.
她恐高，總是會感到眩暈。

NONE: › great energy and enthusiasm
精力；活力；熱情

example: She delivered her speech with tremendous wit and verve.
她發表演講時飽含激情，妙語連珠。

NONE: A1 (used to add emphasis to an adjective or adverb) to a great degree or extremely
（用於強調形容詞或副詞）很，非常
› used to add force to a superlative adjective or to the adjectives "own" or "same"
（用於強調形容詞最高級或 own，same 等形容詞）完全，最，正是

before noun: C2 (used to add emphasis to a noun) exact or particular
（用於強調名詞）同一的，恰好的，正是的

「你累了嗎?」「不，不太累。」
Thank you very much.
非常感謝。
